name: Paramount+ (live CBS)
notes: Live TV on the Premium plan only: your local CBS station (in most markets) plus CBS Sports HQ and other streaming channels ESPN never lists, so in practice it gives TappedIn one channel, CBS. /live-tv/ opens the player (/live-tv/stream/) with a guide of a.channel rows whose links are href="#", so the lineup comes from the schedule.json the page downloads: each channel's slug is its URL (paramountplus.com/live-tv/stream/<slug>/), the local station is the only channelTypes live_local, labelled by its brand ("CBS"), and require keeps only that row: other names or slugs would be taken for networks they aren't ("CBS Sports HQ" for CBS Sports Network, "nfl-on-cbs" for NFL Network). Premium plays 3 streams at once (its plan page). Signed out or without Premium, /live-tv/ sends you to /account/signup/live-tv/, and appUrl leaves out /account/ pages so that never counts as signed in. Your local station follows your location. Page and schedule.json read from a Premium account in Boston (WBZ), October 2026; tuning and playback not yet confirmed.

signin.instructions: Sign in to Paramount+ in the window that opened (and pick your profile if asked). TappedIn continues once the Live TV page appears. Live TV needs the Premium plan: without it Paramount+ keeps showing its plan page
